sections.title: Computer Vision Applications for Atlanta Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade CV solutions for Atlanta's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Retail and Self-Checkout Technology CV
paragraphs: For NCR Corporation (Atlanta HQ) and the retail technology community:

Self-checkout loss prevention CV: Computer vision for NCR's self-checkout systems — detecting scan avoidance, weight discrepancy between scanned items and bagged items, and item substitution for the 150,000+ NCR self-checkout lanes deployed in US grocery and mass merchandise retailers.

Store operations analytics: Anonymous shopper counting, queue detection, and store traffic analysis for NCR's retail technology customers — enabling store managers to allocate staffing based on real-time customer traffic without tracking individual customers.

Product recognition for unattended retail: CV for NCR's grab-and-go and autonomous convenience formats — identifying and pricing items selected from smart coolers and unattended retail locations without traditional checkout.
Cost: $55,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | Privacy-preserving design

blocks.heading: Home Improvement Retail and Supply Chain CV
paragraphs: For Home Depot (Atlanta HQ) and the home improvement retail supply chain:

Lumber and bulk material inspection: Computer vision for Home Depot's lumber and building materials inspection — detecting warping, splits, knots-in-critical-locations, and damage that creates customer returns and product complaints in Home Depot's high-volume lumber business.

Distribution center vision: Automated package inspection, damage detection, and label verification for Home Depot's large distribution center network serving metro Atlanta's enormous home improvement demand.
Job site AI: Computer vision for contractor job site safety monitoring — PPE detection and site condition monitoring for Home Depot's Pro customer community.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks

blocks.heading: Hartsfield-Jackson Airport Operations
paragraphs: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International — the world's busiest airport (100+ million annual passengers) — creates specific aviation operations CV demand:

Ground operations monitoring: CV for aircraft ground equipment detection, FOD (Foreign Object Debris) identification, and aircraft parking position verification in Hartsfield's complex apron operations.
Baggage handling analytics: Computer vision for baggage conveyor monitoring — identifying jammed bags, misrouted luggage, and handling errors in Hartsfield's enormous baggage system.
Security queue analytics: Anonymous crowd density and queue length monitoring for TSA and airport operations management at Hartsfield's high-volume security checkpoints.
Cost: $60,000–$160,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks | TSA, FAA operational context

blocks.heading: Healthcare Clinical Imaging
paragraphs: For Emory Healthcare, Children's Healthcare of Atlanta (CHOA), and Grady Health System:

Pediatric imaging AI: Computer vision for CHOA's pediatric radiology — bone age estimation, fracture detection, and developmental abnormality identification calibrated to pediatric population reference ranges.
Oncology pathology AI: Whole-slide image analysis for Winship Cancer Institute (Emory's cancer center) — tumor grading and biomarker scoring from digital pathology slides.

Emergency medicine imaging triage: Acute finding detection in emergency department imaging for Grady Health's high-volume Level I trauma center — prioritizing time-sensitive findings for radiologist attention.
Cost: $65,000–$175,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | HIPAA + FDA SaMD awareness

blocks.heading: Construction Site Safety
paragraphs: Atlanta's active commercial construction market — new multifamily, office, and industrial development throughout the metro:

PPE compliance monitoring: AI detecting hard hat, vest, and fall protection harness compliance on Atlanta construction sites — aligning with OSHA and Georgia State Board of Workers' Compensation safety requirements.
Progress monitoring: Drone and fixed-camera progress monitoring for Atlanta's active construction projects — comparing to project schedules and identifying delay indicators.
Cost: $45,000–$120,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | OSHA compliance context

sections.description: Key considerations for CV development in Atlanta.

blocks.heading: Privacy for NCR retail CV
paragraphs: NCR's self-checkout CV must not collect or process biometric identifiers — Georgia's PIPA (Personal Information Protection Act) and the general retail environment's sensitivity to customer surveillance create the same anonymization requirement for Atlanta as other US markets. ClickMasters designs NCR-adjacent retail CV as anonymous aggregate analytics.

blocks.heading: High-throughput airport CV
paragraphs: Hartsfield-Jackson's enormous operation requires CV systems that can handle the world's highest airport traffic densities — ClickMasters designs airport CV with the high-throughput, low-latency architecture that world's-busiest-airport operations require.
